output_list.reason: The 'transfer' function has an integer overflow that can lead to unintended token distribution.
The 'transferFrom' function has an integer overflow that can allow attackers to steal funds from user accounts.
The 'approve' function has an integer overflow, allowing the owner to set arbitrary large allowance.
The 'mintToken' function only allows the owner to increase the total supply and the balance of a specified target, lack of restrictions on reducing supply can lead to financial loss to token holders.
The 'freezeAccount' function allows the owner to arbitrarily freeze accounts, causing a loss of funds for users without any apparent safeguard.
